card.architecture: SD3 (MMDiT, 8.1B) — full bf16 with external triple CLIP (clip-l + clip-g + t5-fp16)
card.summary: The 8.1B SD3.5 Large flagship at full bf16 precision with the fp16 T5 encoder (24 GB). Higher fidelity and cleaner typography than the fp8 build; strong adherence on complex prompts.
card.pick_when: Top SD3.5 quality on a 24 GB card (full bf16 + fp16 T5).

prompt.guidance: Detailed English; low CFG (~4-4.5). Quote short in-image text.
prompt.example: a cinematic wide shot of a neon cyberpunk market in the rain, volumetric fog, ultra-detailed
prompt.instructions: Specific, detailed natural-language prompts; SD3.5 Large leads the family in adherence. ~20-28 steps, cfg ~4-4.5, euler/sgm_uniform, ~1 MP. Quote in-image text and keep it short. Negatives optional/minimal.

speed.measured_note: 8.1B bf16 + fp16 T5 on 24 GB; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two. More detail usually looks better.
